topic: procedures, return addresses, ABI and recursion
scope: System V AMD64 ABI as used on common Unix-like x86-64 systems; Windows x64 and special argument classes differ.
assumptions: Typical near CALL/RET shown; exact stack frame allocation is compiler dependent
Factorial toy widget accepts n=0..6, so integer arithmetic does not overflow

claims.claim: Six first integer/pointer arguments use rdi,rsi,rdx,rcx,r8,r9 in typical SysV AMD64 cases
Caller stack aligns to 16 bytes at CALL boundary, callee enters with rsp+8 aligned
Frame-pointer omission and optimizations are toolchain dependent
System V AMD64 可变参数调用中，序言把 6 个整数寄存器与 8 个 SSE 寄存器降入 176 B 寄存器保存区，%al 给出使用过的 SSE 寄存器个数上界

sources.locator: Register save area; argument passing for variadic functions

claims.notes: 仅限于 System V AMD64；Windows x64 变参规则不同；模型见 examples/deep-ch05-08-b.py 06b

interaction: factorial call chain for n 0 through 6; conceptual frames, not offsets
